_comment: TEMPERATE SPAWN CONTINENT. minecraft:overworld/temperature is continent-sized, so a whole spawn continent can come out in one band (all frozen, say). This blends toward a temperate climate (terra_continental:temperature_temperate = 0.4 x a finer temperature noise: mostly temperate, some cool and warm pockets) by terra_continental:spawn_climate_mask, which is 1 across the spawn continent and fades to 0 beyond it: t + mask * (temperate - t). Every other continent keeps the plain temperature. Biome selection only; terrain never reads temperature. Strength and radii: [biomes] temperate_spawn_* in terra_continental-common.toml.
